scope: Ranked grouped findings and next actions, not a total count of defective recipes. Candidates require verification; coverage gaps are not confirmed defects.

findings.title: Doneness guidance falls short of authoritative recommendations
findings.evidence: The recipe specifies 125°F and a five-minute rest for tenderloin strips, with no documented alternative time-temperature process. Separately, sheet-pan pineapple shrimp tacos use pink as the sole doneness cue, omitting the FDA firmness/opacity cue.
findings.nextAction: Review the endpoint against the intended preparation and authoritative guidance. Do not describe the entire recipe as proven unsafe.

findings.title: Unspecified plastic wrap in an oven water bath
findings.evidence: The method seals the terrine in unspecified plastic wrap during a 325°F oven bake. Product suitability is not established.
findings.nextAction: Verify manufacturer-rated suitability or choose a supported preparation method before changing instructions.

findings.title: Ten meal-body links resolve to absent generated routes
findings.evidence: Ten ../recipes/ links across Indian Curry Night, Saag Paneer Dinner and Indian Dal Night resolve under /mise/meals/recipes/ from trailing-slash meal URLs. Correct recipe destinations exist under /mise/recipes/.
findings.nextAction: Replace these relative links with site-base-aware recipe URLs and retain a rendered anchor check.
findings.confidence: high for generated routes; live HTTP status unverified

findings.title: Required ingredients absent from recipe lists
findings.evidence: Yellow cake and skillet biscuits require unlisted baking powder; other context-checked examples require unlisted garlic, oil, seasoning or binding water. Historical and sample overlap is deduplicated here.
findings.nextAction: Resolve consequential missing amounts from source evidence; do not bulk-invent quantities.

findings.title: Elapsed plans omit required preparation
findings.evidence: Terrine total is 105 minutes but chilling alone requires at least four hours. Four composed-meal schedules also conflict with their referenced components; details are in reconciliation.md.
findings.nextAction: Correct the terrine elapsed-time model and align four meal schedules with components and advance-preparation assumptions.

findings.title: Necessary ingredient destinations and allocations are unclear
findings.evidence: Listed baking powder is excluded from enumerated dry mixes; vanilla and seasonings are reused across components without divisions in separately verified examples. The sampled strawberry-rhubarb shortcake also uses additional sugar/liqueur in its cream component without a separately listed allocation.
findings.nextAction: Recover and record intended allocations; use structured quantities where they prevent an established drift risk.

findings.title: Dietary labels need default-versus-alternative clarity
findings.evidence: Vegan-tagged patatas bravas requires unqualified mayonnaise; corpus screening also found conditional dairy and honey paths. Empty tags alone are not defects.
findings.nextAction: Make the intended vegan/default/optional ingredient requirements explicit after individual context review.
findings.confidence: high for the written ambiguity; medium for classification correction

findings.title: Malformed generic rest guidance reaches public prose
findings.evidence: The tart says Let Cold Butt rest. Eighteen recipes match the generic rest explanation; only the malformed example is confirmed here.
findings.nextAction: Inspect the small candidate set and remove malformed or irrelevant appended advice without broad rewriting.

findings.title: No documented kitchen testing
findings.evidence: Zero canonical recipes are recorded as kitchen-tested. Editorial review cannot establish taste or reproducibility.
findings.nextAction: Select a small set of changed formulas and representative complete meals for actual cooking records.

findings.title: Performance, print and comprehensive keyboard accessibility not established
findings.evidence: Representative functionality is observed, but full measurement and accessibility coverage remain limited to what the website report explicitly records.
findings.nextAction: Run one bounded measurement and keyboard/print pass before making broad website-quality claims.
